newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB may have sold 150,000 T barley to Saudi - trade.
newsitem.headline: CWB may have sold 150,000 T barley to Saudi - trade.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board sought to sell 150,000 of Saudi Arabia's 500,000 tonne feed barley, trade sources said.
"The Saudis took a little bit from everyone. The Board (CWB) was looking to sell 150,000 tonnes but the major part came from Europe," one source said.
The CWB declined to confirm or deny the trade rumour.

"If we could do business with the Saudis we would but I can't confim that they have taken a portion or all of the 500,000 tonnes but I would think it would be a portion," CWB spokesman Jim Pietryk said.
Another source said most of the feed barley was sold out of Europe.

"People are wary of buying from Canada at even money because of our logistical problems," one source said. Extreme weather and equipment failure have led to vessel backlogs at Canadian export ports since early January.
